groups.android: Android System Settings (No Android UI needed)

language.label: Display Language
language.sub: Language used for the ApkStart user interface, takes effect immediately.

runtime.setupNote: Fully automatic: No need to choose image, enable acceleration, or tune memory
runtime.guideSub: VM window is open. Follow these 6 steps once, then ApkStart will boot directly from disk without needing the ISO.
runtime.guideStep1: Boot Menu: Use ↓ to select Installation - Install Android-x86 to harddisk, press Enter
runtime.guideStep2: Choose Partition: Select Create/Modify partitions; choose No when asked for GPT
runtime.guideStep3: cfdisk: New → Primary → Press Enter for full size → Bootable → Write → type yes → Quit
runtime.guideStep5: GRUB & System: Select Yes for Install GRUB; select Yes for Install /system as read-write
runtime.guideStep6: Finish: Once progress reaches 100%, click "I have completed installation" below (ApkStart will reboot and take over)
runtime.guideTip: If ADB fails to connect later: in VM window press Ctrl+Alt+F1 to open terminal, run setprop service.adb.tcp.port 5555, stop adbd, start adbd, then press Ctrl+Alt+F7 to return to GUI.

auto.profileSub: RAM, CPU cores, graphics backend, ports, and acceleration are automatically configured; auto fallbacks on launch failures. ApkStart uses a dedicated ADB port 5044 (host default is 5037) for deliberate isolation. To connect manually, set $env:ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT=5044 first. Note: do not run adb connect 127.0.0.1:5555 manually or it triggers USB debugging prompts on running apps.
auto.usageLabel: Total Disk Usage (Runtime + Android Data + Cache)
auto.chkCleanSnapshots: Also clear current AVD quickboot snapshots (stops runtime first, reclaims several GBs)
auto.usageSub: Base system image is shared system-wide; app data is saved in differential layers. Old images, snapshots, logs, and locks can be recycled. Logs auto-rotate when reaching limits. "Reset Android Data" permanently deletes several GBs of user data, keeping only system files.
auto.diagNote: Diagnostic reports are used for troubleshooting; rebuild restores desktop + Start menu entries
auto.autoStartSub: Runs in system tray on Windows login. Double-click desktop icons to launch apps instantly without manual startup.

window.modeWindow: Windowed (Resizable, remembers window size per app)
window.modeFullscreen: Fullscreen (Fills screen, black borders on sides)
window.displayModeSub: Press F11 or right-click tray icon to toggle anytime; fullscreen scales window without altering aspect ratio or restarting apps.
window.autoFullscreenOn: On · Launch all apps in fullscreen automatically
window.autoFullscreenSub: When enabled, apps fill screen immediately upon opening. Works best with Landscape mode below — widescreen aspect ratio fits host monitors without side bars.
window.orientationAuto: Follow App (Recommended · Auto landscape/portrait, no black bars)
window.orientationPortrait: Force Portrait (Phone aspect ratio, ideal for TikTok/reels/reading)
window.orientationLandscape: Force Landscape (Widescreen, ideal for videos and games)
window.orientationSub: Android orientation depends on the virtual phone display panel's physical orientation. When mismatched, Android renders narrow centered letterboxing. "Follow App" reads the APK's orientation and adjusts panel automatically on launch. Restarts runtime only once when orientation changes (~10s), then all apps in that orientation launch instantly.
window.tabletSub: At 720 width with 190 dpi (~606dp), it exceeds Android's 600dp tablet breakpoint, unlocking split-view pages and dual-column layouts. Turning off reverts to standard phone layout. Changes take effect on next app launch.
window.panelSub: Current physical panel direction used by the runtime, auto-configured by orientation policy above.
window.embedMode: Embedded (Default) · Android embedded in ApkStart window, unified look
window.detachedMode: Detached · Native emulator window, prevents glitches/black bars/misclicks
window.windowEmbedSub: Embedded mode gives a cohesive single-window feel, but embeds the emulator window inside ApkStart. Detached mode lets the emulator manage its own window directly, eliminating display artifacts or DPI click issues at the cost of an extra taskbar icon. Takes effect on next app launch.
window.portraitSub: Window can be resized freely; this setting adjusts Android internal rendering resolution. Lower resolutions consume fewer system resources.

mouse.leftClickSub: Native emulator maps left click to finger touch, drag to swipe. No extra setup required.
mouse.rightBackSub: Emulator defaults right click as a tap. When enabled, right click executes Android Back without triggering touches.
mouse.wheelSmooth: Smooth (Recommended) · Combines multiple wheel events into a smooth swipe
mouse.wheelSub: Smooth mode aggregates scrolls in a short timeframe into a continuous swipe gesture, avoiding stutter.
mouse.sideButtonsLabel: Mouse Side Buttons · Back / Forward (Default: Off)
mouse.sideButtonsSub: Requires a mouse hook. Only active when ApkStart app window is focused, unloaded immediately when defocused to avoid desktop impact.
mouse.note: These mappings are only active when an app window is focused; Windows native behavior resumes as soon as focus leaves.

keymap.enableSub: Map keyboard keys to Android screen taps and swipes. Perfect for mobile games (WASD movement, skill keys, etc.). Configurable per app by right-clicking app card → Keymapping.
keymap.hint: No keymapping configured for current app. Right-click app card to apply presets.

perf.resSave: Power Saver · 2 Cores / Lower Priority / 540p (Older PCs, AFK)
perf.resSmooth: Performance · All Cores / Normal Priority (Videos, Games)
perf.resSub: Controls CPU allocation and visual quality. Switch to Performance for video/gaming, or Power Saver for background tasks. Takes effect on next app launch.
perf.growSub: Expansion is performed in-place: installed apps and save data are preserved; next boot takes ~10s longer.
perf.localeSub: Language for system settings, permissions, and dates. Injected into VM on boot, takes effect on next runtime restart.
perf.chineseImeSub: System image only includes LatinIME. Check this to silently install and enable Google Pinyin IME for typing Chinese in apps.
perf.fastDnsSub: Assigns high-speed public DNS to Android. Fixes slow initial loading when host is connected to VPN or corporate networks.
perf.audioSub: Plays app notifications and media sound. Turn off only to save minor CPU if audio is not needed.
perf.keepSnapshotSub: Subsequent app launches take only seconds, using ~2–3 GB disk space for ram.bin. Turn off if disk space is tight.
perf.liteModeSub: Caps vCPU allocation and lowers process priority, giving priority to Windows desktop. Managed automatically by Resource Profile above.
perf.priGame: Game / Low Latency · High priority, best for FPS & rhythm games
perf.priSub: Game mode maintains high CPU priority and reduces polling intervals for lowest input latency, but may slow other host tasks.
perf.deepTrimSub: Disables Play Store, Setup Wizard, and print services. If an app reports missing Google Play Services, turn this off to restore them.
perf.prewarmSub: Boots Android environment silently in background upon launching ApkStart. Subsequent app opens drop from 20s to near instant. Uses ~1GB idle RAM.
perf.idleNote: Android environment boots once and stays active. Opening apps launches them without rebooting system. Closing all windows parks container.

download.sourceSub: Auto probes both GitHub and Gitee, tests 256KB download speeds, and selects the fastest mirror.
download.autoMirrorSub: When GitHub direct connection is slow, probes public mirrors (ghfast.top / gh-proxy.com).
download.mirrorPrefixSub: When provided, uses this mirror prefix exclusively instead of auto mirrors.
download.connectionsSub: Parallel block downloading for large files. Default 8 threads saturates most broadband connections; try 16 on fast networks.
download.giteeTokenPlaceholder: Leave blank: public repos are readable anonymously
download.giteeTokenSub: Gitee release lists are public. Only needed if rate-limited (HTTP 403/429) or accessing private branches.

preflight.desc: Inspects CPU virtualization, Windows hypervisor platform, GPU model, VRAM, and RAM. Auto-configures optimal settings and recommends fixes.

drivers.desc: Compatibility patches for specific GPUs and systems. Drivers are JSON configs specifying matching hardware and boot arguments without executing arbitrary code.
drivers.exportSub: "Export Local Template" fills matching hardware rules for this PC. See docs/drivers.md for details.

advanced.runtimeSub: ApkStart manages its own runtime: ADB, emulator, and system images are fully isolated from any third-party emulators (MuMu, LDPlayer, BlueStacks, WSA).
advanced.adbPlaceholder: Leave blank to auto-detect in PATH / Android SDK
advanced.deviceAddrSub: Auto-allocated by ApkStart (emulator-5554, rolls over on port conflicts).
advanced.systemImagePlaceholder: Path to Android-x86 / Bliss OS ISO or IMG file
advanced.compatSub: Standard Android 14 image supports both x86 and ARM apps seamlessly. Kept for legacy compatibility.

android.tuneSub: Disables animations, raises background process limits, and whitelists current app for battery optimization.
android.wifiSub: Internal Android VM Wi-Fi; disabling saves minor CPU.
android.airplaneSub: Completely cuts off networking for quiet testing.
android.animSub: Disabling animations significantly speeds up UI transitions.

desktop.autoShortcutLabel: Auto create desktop shortcut on install
desktop.autoShortcutSub: Shortcuts feature high-resolution app icons; double-click opens app directly.
desktop.startMenuShortcutSub: Enables Windows Search indexing and grouped taskbar icons.
desktop.rebuildSub: Click here to restore all shortcuts if accidentally deleted or blocked by antivirus.

share.hostDirSub: Existing files are automatically migrated to new directory when changed.
share.note: Both folders sync bidirectionally in real time; files saved by Android apps appear on host PC.

system.assocSub: Double-click APK files to install directly into ApkStart (Current user only, no admin required)
system.runtimeDirSub: Uses substantial disk space (several GBs). Moving to a secondary drive relieves C: drive pressure. Requires restart; please move existing files manually.
system.avdDirPlaceholder: Default: avd folder inside runtime directory
system.avdDirSub: Primary storage space consumer: data partition (default 6GB) + quickboot snapshot (2-3GB). Move to D: or another partition when disk space is tight.
system.uninstallSub: Removes .apk file associations and program files. Portable edition can be removed by deleting folder.

update.note: Fetches latest release from GitHub (RoutineMiku/apkstart). Updates replace app binaries without affecting installed apps or runtime data.

about.desc: Double-click to install Android app runner for Windows: APK installation, desktop shortcuts, standalone windows, and two-way file sharing.

toast.runtimeReadyBody: You can now drag APK files into the window or double-click desktop shortcuts.
